description: How a Section 32 settlement divides: any Medicare set-aside comes off first, the attorney fee is 15% of the rest rounded down to $5, and the remainder is the claimant's net. Optional prior-counsel fee split (the OC-400.1 requests only the current attorney's share). The fee the Judge approves can differ. New York State only. Computes with The Comp Desk calc-core (the engine behind the app, the website calculators and the Pro Workspace); it never estimates. If an input is missing it returns status "missing" with every input still needed and calculates nothing. Returns the figures, the rate year used, the formulas with their citations (each flagged with whether it has been attorney-reviewed), and the not-legal-advice notice.

msa_amount.description: Optional: the Medicare set-aside, in dollars.

prior_counsel_fees.description: Optional. Dollar amount of the fee apportioned to each prior counsel (one or two). The current attorney gets the rest of the fee.
